risk_categories.name: Supply Disruption Risk
risk_categories.description: Risk of supply interruption due to supplier failure, natural disaster, or capacity constraints

risk_categories.name: Quality Risk
risk_categories.description: Risk of receiving non-conforming materials that impact production or end product quality

risk_categories.name: Logistics Risk
risk_categories.description: Risk of delivery delays, damage during transit, or logistics infrastructure failure

risk_categories.name: Financial Risk
risk_categories.description: Risk related to supplier financial health, currency fluctuation, or cost volatility

risk_categories.name: Geopolitical Risk
risk_categories.description: Risk from political instability, trade restrictions, sanctions, or regulatory changes

risk_categories.name: Cybersecurity/IP Risk
risk_categories.description: Risk of data breach, IP theft, or cyber attack on supply chain systems

1.label: Rare
1.description: May occur only in exceptional circumstances (<5% probability in 12 months)

2.label: Unlikely
2.description: Could occur but not expected (5-20% probability)

3.label: Possible
3.description: Might occur at some time (20-50% probability)

4.label: Likely
4.description: Will probably occur in most circumstances (50-80% probability)

Critical.action: Escalate to senior management, immediate action
